name: Immer
overview: Immer was a male biblical figure known primarily as the father of Zadok, as recorded in Nehemiah 3:29. There is no information about his tribal affiliation or additional personal details. His mention is brief and focused on his paternal connection.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Immer' is a proper name meaning 'lamb.' This meaning is noted but not indicated as given directly by God. The significance of the name is straightforward and reflects a common Hebrew personal name.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Immer as the father of Zadok, establishing a direct paternal relationship. No other family connections are recorded beyond this relationship in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Immer's significance in the biblical narrative is tied to his role as the father of Zadok, who is mentioned in the context of the rebuilding efforts in Nehemiah. Although Immer himself is not the primary focus, his mention helps to identify and situate Zadok within the community during this important period of restoration.
